title: Shrink-stage PCA threshold for the auxiliary basis in GW/RPA

shrink_abfs_pca_thr.meaning: When non-negative, shrinks the auxiliary basis for GW/RPA at the shrink stage; smaller values keep more auxiliary functions and reduce the EXX LRI error.

adjust.symptom: EXX bands show small-range bumps or locally non-smooth segments
adjust.effect: keeps more shrunk auxiliary functions and reduces the EXX LRI error
adjust.guard: too small a value enlarges the basis and can introduce linear dependence; verify the Coulomb spectrum and retained rank

constraints: The ABACUS default is -1 (shrinking disabled); the oml default template pins 1e-4.
This is a different parameter from exx_pca_threshold: it acts at the shrink stage, not at ABFS generation.
